def centered_hexagonal_number(n):
    return 3 * n * (n - 1) + 1


assert centered_hexagonal_number(10) == 271

The formula is 3n(n−1) + 1. The center dot plus six rings, where ring k adds 6(k−1) dots, sums to this closed form. The team note's other option, n(2n−1), gives 190 for n = 10, so it doesn't satisfy the assertion.
